issues.description: Constructor parameter order for class Lecture is inconsistent between the problem statement/UML and the solution. The problem statement and UML require the Lecture constructor parameters to follow the UML attribute order: numberOfInscribedStudents, lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfTutors. The solution implementation defines the constructor as: Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and lead to incompatible code or test expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML/instructions. Preferred fix: change the solution constructor signature to match the UML order and update the constructor body accordingly, e.g. public Lecture(int numberOfInscribedStudents, String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfTutors) { this.numberOfInscribedStudents = numberOfInscribedStudents; this.lectureName = lectureName; this.numberOfLecturers = numberOfLecturers; this.numberOfGuestStudents = numberOfGuestStudents; this.numberOfTutors = numberOfTutors; }. Alternatively, if the chosen constructor order in the solution is intentional, update the problem statement/UML to describe that same parameter order and adjust any example usage/tests to match.
